facts.text: Cross-cultural study is a mandatory graduation requirement for every student at Eastern Mennonite University, typically satisfied through a semester-long immersion or domestic experience.

sources.title: Summer Cross-Cultural Students Return from Around the Globe - EMU
sources.quote: Cross-cultural study is a graduation requirement for every EMU student. Our well-known program – over three decades old – is boosted by a majority of teaching faculty who have lived and worked overseas
